sonnet.problem: The story card says Jacob 'has been working for his father-in-law Laban, and he's gotten rich doing it'. That hands the baker the right answer to the choice card right after it (card 2: 'He built all his wealth off their father'). It also makes the two wrong answers look unlikely, since they say nothing about wealth.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
